whatsNew: Android now starts at an 80% WebView scale for a more compact layout, with pinch-to-zoom disabled.
The Android bottom-center Home button has been refined with a compact premium gold design and circular logo treatment.
The Android startup screen now shows the full E-Football logo on a branded dark background while the app loads.
The homepage Menu control and drawer now have stronger contrast, cinematic glass styling, gold detailing, glow, depth, and clearer icon states.
The app footer continues to display the current release version from live release metadata.
Admin App Updater now supports Refresh version to synchronize the Android version, build number, and What's New with the release files.
